articles.title: Now is the time to accumulate bitcoin, Galaxy says

articles.title: Ethereum fixes Glamsterdam bug that could have sent staking deposits to builders
articles.snippet: Developers initially rejected the change before reversing course, as testing delays gave them more time to examine a flaw in Ethereum's upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade.

articles.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine favors share buybacks to ether purchases as crypto declines
articles.snippet: The Ethereum treasury firm spent $46 million buying back shares as Chairman Tom Lee said crypto has held up better than AI stocks during the recent market pullback.

articles.title: CFTC sues Utah to block action against prediction markets
articles.snippet: The US state filed a lawsuit against Kalshi last week, seeking to recover up to $60 million in profits related to event contracts on prediction markets.
